title: [APK 2026] APK 2026 in Seoul sets stage for deeper AI, supply chain ties amid global turmoil
caption:
At the APK 2026 summit in Seoul, German and Korean leaders mapped out AI‑driven manufacturing and chip collaborations. The new framework aims to make supply chains more resilient while pushing greener production.

Source: Koreaherald - [APK 2026] APK 2026 in Seoul sets stage for deeper AI, supply chain ties amid global turmoil
